name: Status
description: One column of a project's board: a status its tasks are in, with a category (to do, doing, done) that says what it means

fields.name: Name
fields.description: The status's name, such as Review

fields.name: Category
fields.description: What being in it means: a task moved to a done status is complete

fields.name: Colour
fields.description: A theme palette name or a CSS colour

fields.name: Position
fields.description: Its place among the project's statuses
